args.prompt:
Create an ENTIRELY NEW complete PHOTOREALISTIC still-life CAMERA PHOTOGRAPH, square 1:1, opaque RGB PNG, at least 1024 by 1024 pixels. This is a new full photograph from scratch, NOT a local edit, background replacement, composite, crop or retouch of any reference. REFERENCE 1 is the APPROVED physical incense-casket design: preserve its geometry, shape, proportions, lid, gold granulation and frankincense resin as faithfully as possible in the newly photographed scene. REFERENCE 2 provides ONLY the game series DARK WARM BROWN softly mottled textured background and soft upper-left oblique lighting. DO NOT reproduce its necklace, bracelets or any other objects. REFERENCE 3 is another game-series background/palette/framing comparison ONLY; do not reproduce its pendant or gemstones.
SUBJECT: exactly ONE small portable ancient South-Arabian inspired gold incense casket, the SAME approved reference-1 design: low rectangular golden box in three-quarter front-right view, four small rounded ball feet, slightly pitched/ridge-shaped hinged lid partly open backward at the SAME angle, broad horizontal gold bands of repeating triangular panels outlined by tiny individually irregular gold granules and three-bead clusters, fine handworked wear and natural gold highlights. Inside are a few large irregular translucent amber-gold FRANKINCENSE RESIN LUMPS; resin stays INSIDE the box. Preserve the distinctive approved open-casket silhouette, fully visible on all sides and with clear margins. One casket with its attached lid is ONE object, not several treasures. Same approximately 75 percent frame width and 60 percent height as approved object, centred slightly low; genuine grounded soft contact shadow.
The entire square background including the ground is DARK, warm umber/chocolate BROWN, subtle naturally mottled old matte brown surface similar to reference 2, softly fading into dark warm corners. No pale parchment, light beige sheet, white background, separate horizon, cloth folds, studio equipment or elaborate ornament. Soft diffused light from upper-left/above makes true gold and resin physically believable without harsh white glare. Real photographed hammered gilded metal, tiny soldered granules and translucent rough resin; no drawn lines, painterly surface, gouache, CGI, procedural AI texture or artificial patterned coating. Respect the accepted object design; no redesign, writing or modern lock. NO necklace, collar, chain, bracelet, brooch, jewels, gems, coins, pearls, additional box, loose resin outside, smoke, person, hands, frame, label, text or logo. Output the WHOLE NEW PHOTO only.

export.method: Pillow full-frame resize LANCZOS then JPEG quality 98, chroma subsampling 0, optimize true

observationsFI: Rasia jatkaa hyväksytyn 634-kuvan matalaa suorakulmaista muotoa, pallojalkoja, avointa harjakantta, kolmiopaneelien granulaatiota ja sisällä olevia hartsimöhkäleitä. Uusi kokonainen generointi ei ole pikselikopio.

Lämmin tumma ruskea tausta, pehmeä mottlaus ja ylävasemman viistovalo vastaavat lähteen pelisarjan suuntaa. Uuden kuvan alareuna on hieman valoisampi ja tausta lämpimämpi kuin vanhassa Lähi-idän mallissa; se säilyy selvästi tummanruskeana.
640-pikselin JPEGissä hartsin läpikuultavuus ja kultapinnan yksityiskohdat erottuvat; koko esine on rajauksen sisällä. Kaulakorua, rannerenkaita, rintakorua tai muita aarteita ei ole.
